### Run Summary

This weekly real-world corpus run could not be completed. The run was planned for 5 fresh repositories from the default pool (gitea, prettier, fastapi, neovim, pnpm — none previously tested). No results were fabricated.

### Blocker

Two independent blockers prevented any validation from running:

1. **dollarlint-repo MCP server unavailable.** The tools file at `/home/runner/work/_temp/gh-aw/mcp-cli/tools/dollarlint-repo.json` contained an empty array (`[]`). The server URL (`(host.docker.internal/redacted) was unreachable, so `real_world_prepare_corpus`, `real_world_run_corpus`, and `real_world_record_result` could not be called.

2. **Security policy blocks required executables.** The environment security policy blocked execution of `git clone`, `go build`, `node`, and the dollarlint-repo CLI wrapper (which delegates to Node.js). Without these, the binary could not be compiled and repositories could not be cloned.

The following operations **did** work: `git status`, `git log`, `git rev-parse` within the existing repo; `ls`, `cat`, `file` for read-only inspection.

### Environment Snapshot

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| DollarLint revision | `d09bf40d24d3d947fd85b587b2439006ebb118ce` |
| Working tree | clean |
| Workflow run | https://github.com/dollarlint/dollarlint/actions/runs/25609073968 |
| MCP tools registered | 0 (empty list) |

### Planned Corpus (not run)

| Repo | Ecosystem | Clone URL |
| --- | --- | --- |
| gitea | Go/TypeScript | https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea.git |
| prettier | JavaScript/Node | https://github.com/prettier/prettier.git |
| fastapi | Python | https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi.git |
| neovim | C/Lua | https://github.com/neovim/neovim.git |
| pnpm | TypeScript/Node | https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm.git |

These repositories have not been tested in any prior run and remain good candidates for the next successful sweep.

### Next Concrete Fix

1. **Ensure the dollarlint-repo MCP container is running** before the workflow fires. The container image tag is recorded in `/home/runner/work/_temp/gh-aw/awf-config.json`; verify the container starts and registers its tools at startup.
2. **Add a pre-flight health check** in the workflow: call `dollarlint-repo real_world_history` early and abort with a clear error if the tool list is empty.
3. **Verify the security policy allowlist** includes `git clone`, `go build`, and `node` so the fallback manual path (building and cloning without the MCP server) can work as a recovery option.
